steps.say: The Rotator is the rotation stage on its SMC100 controller. After Launch in Setup it appears in the sidebar under its name; press the name to open this page.
There is no rotator simulator: on a SIM port, or with no stage answering, every control that needs the stage is greyed out. On a real stage the angle is read four times a second.
Past ±30° the stage risks damaging the tubing. Every move is judged on where it lands: one that would end beyond ±30° asks you first, and so does a relative move while the position is unknown.
Step is the size of one relative move, in degrees (1.0 to start with). A step of 0 is refused, not sent.
Move + and Move - turn the stage by one Step. Each is counted from the last target you sent, not the last reading, so several quick presses add up and are checked against ±30° together.
Home sends the stage to 0°. After power-up or a reset the controller reads Not referenced, and Home is how it finds its zero.

Stop motion halts the stage where it is, at once, without latching. The stage did not reach its target, so that target is forgotten. Only one move runs at a time: a second press while one is moving is refused.
An absolute move and the controller reset sit one level down. Press Configure Rotator to open them.
Move to turns the stage to the Target angle (-175° to 175°), under the same ±30° check.
Reset & configure resets the SMC100, reloads the stage's own settings, then homes it, so it moves and asks first. Use it when the controller reports an error.
Open Diagnostics for the controller's state, its connection lamp and this device's own stop.
Motion state is the controller's word: Ready, Moving, Homing, Not referenced, Disabled or Configuring. If the stage stops answering it reads Communication lost and the position goes blank.
The stop: the Stop disc on the rail, or Ctrl+. from anywhere on the page, halts every device at once and latches it. The moves grey out until the stop is cleared.
When every device is stopped the disc reads Clear; pressing it asks, then clears. Clearing moves nothing. Ctrl+. only ever stops.
Stop this model halts and latches only the Rotator. Pressed again (it then reads Stopped) it clears just this one, after asking.

A move that does not finish, or a controller error, shows here: check the stage, then use Reset & configure. If the controller will not answer, use Hard reset on its row in Setup, or check its cable and power.
